To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of antibiotics is a double-edged sword.

1) the overuse and inappropriate use of antibiotics has led to the emergence of resistant bacteria; 2) the emergence of resistant bacterial infections is associated with significant morbidity and mortality; 3) the development of novel antibiotics to treat resistant bacteria is slow, expensive, and fraught with risk; and 4) the judicious use of existing antibiotics by clinicians will slow the emergence of resistant infections.
